mentions.name: KPBJ FM
mentions.description: A low power FM (LPFM) community radio station serving the East San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles. The station puts on local events (including a big show in Burbank with several hundred attendees) to fundraise for building out the station, and was featured on the local NPR syndicate.
mentions.audience: Local community in the East San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing to work on a Low Power FM community radio station for the East San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles. We have started promoting and putting on local events and are trying to fund raise to build out the station.
